Widget family: RADIO

Strict visual criteria (PASS only if ALL hold for the claimed state):

UNCHECKED:
1. A circular radio control is visible (round outer ring, not a square checkbox).
2. Interior has no filled inner disc/dot that reads as selected.

CHECKED / SELECTED:
1. Outer circular ring remains visible.
2. A filled inner circle (disc) is centered inside the ring — solid and clearly smaller than the outer ring.
3. FAIL if: empty ring only, square checkbox with X/check, a single pixel speck, an X mark, or a filled square.

DISABLED: control and mark (if any) are visibly dimmed vs enabled.
